cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Framed Lab Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing scene card for building a pretend framed view of a tidepool lab: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one scene card, set out pencils, and ask the writer to imagine the frame shows a tiny lab shelf beside ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Look through an imagined window frame into the Tidepool Timekeepers Lab, then write one clear setting clue: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: Through the pretend frame, the tidepool lab first shows ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: This setting feels busy, calm, or curious because ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A tidepool timekeeper checks a paper chart when the framed view reveals ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First-line path: From the window seat, the lab looked like ____________________, and the first clue was ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact color, shape, or sound that makes the lab easier to picture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the framed lab first, then label one setting clue here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card to continue a tidepool lab scene about ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Framed Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing scene card for revising one ferry view from fuzzy to clear: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one scene card and ask the writer to place a pretend draft sentence inside the window frame: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine the ferry passing through a framed view, then revise one draft line so the reader sees it clearly: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The first draft view of Revision River Ferry says ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: My clearer ferry view changes that line to ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A ferry guide spots a draft page drifting near ____________________ and asks for a clearer scene.
cards.firstLinePath: First-line path: The old sentence showed ____________________; the revised sentence shows ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Cut one extra phrase or add one precise ferry detail here: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Underline one word silently, then write the clearer replacement here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card to polish a ferry scene about ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Window Label
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing scene card for turning an invented museum label into a framed view: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one scene card, draw a simple frame on scrap paper if helpful, and ask for one exhibit label idea: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine a tower museum label seen through a pretend frame, then add details that make the clue clear: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The label inside the framed tower view names an exhibit called ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The label needs a shape ____________________, a texture ____________________, and a clue ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A museum helper notices the label changes when the frame points toward ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First-line path: The label looked ordinary until ____________________ made the tower scene feel ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain label word with a sharper shape, texture, or action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the label box first, then write one exact clue: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card to begin a quiet tower scene about ____________________.

cards.title: Almost Invention Workshop Object View
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing scene card for giving one almost-working object a clear story job: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one scene card and invite the writer to place a made-up invention inside the pretend frame: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine a workshop object seen from a window seat, then name what part almost works and what detail matters: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: In the framed workshop view, the almost invention is called ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: The part that almost works is ____________________, and the missing detail is ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A workshop helper notices the object changes when ____________________ is added to the paper plan.
cards.firstLinePath: First-line path: The first test looked like ____________________, but the better scene shows ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague object word with a precise noun, part, or action: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the invention shape silently, then label the most important part: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card to write an almost-invention scene about ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Clear Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led, offline, paper-only creative writing scene card for making a boardwalk scene easier to understand: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print one scene card, set out blank paper, and ask the writer to place one cloudy sentence in the frame: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine Binding Day Boardwalk through a framed view, then rewrite one unclear sentence with a stronger detail: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Scene front: The cloudy boardwalk sentence in the frame says ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Scene back: My clearer boardwalk sentence says ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A page binder pauses beside ____________________ because one sentence needs a clearer scene.
cards.firstLinePath: First-line path: The first line said ____________________; the clearer line shows ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Swap one fuzzy word for a precise noun, verb, or visible detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Work silently by copying only the clearer sentence here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Save this card to finish a boardwalk scene about ____________________.
